svg.title: 主人公・back（立ち＝歩行コマ0）
svg.desc: Front derived from the supplied girl_idle.png with its matte removed, both hands raising the end-on torch lamp so the pose matches the supplied side views' extended arm; back is an adaptation of it (unseen details are not assertions about the original design). Left/right are the supplied girl_left.png and girl_right.png cleaned on the original 60x60 grid: white matte, floor oval and broken curl pixels removed, edge colours un-blended from the background. Walk frames reposition the legs and bob the body one pixel.
